name: Ewellix LIFTKIT-0S, 1400 mm stroke
price_basis: assumed low-cost equivalent of the listed part: 5 x sqrt(list price), to the nearest $5 (see catalog/README.md, Prices)
notes: STAND-IN geometry (two boxes: a fixed outer column and a moving stage). Numbers from the Ewellix LIFTKIT-0S datasheet: retracted = stroke/2 + 0.275 m, 21 kg at zero stroke + 1.7 kg per 0.5 m, 1500 N push load. No CAD in hand. Mounts onto a base's 'top'; its 'stage' takes an arm, and 'stage_rear' / 'stage_front' take a lidar / the ego camera.
